newsitem.title: UK: Yahoo! launches local UK Internet guide.
newsitem.headline: Yahoo! launches local UK Internet guide.

text.p: Online Internet guide Yahoo! Inc launched a localised UK version of its service on Monday and plans to add local-language sites for France and Germany next month, the company said in a statement.

Yahoo! UK provides access to what it calls the most comprehensive guide to UK web sites available and a complete database of worldwide listings. It comprises more than 12,000 UK and Irish Internet services at launch.
It will be the only web site in Britain to provide headline news and full text from Reuters, via UK newsfeeds in business, sports and general news.
Reuters New Media, a unit of international news and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc has a small stake in Yahoo! and supplies it with news.
